Executive SummaryUnflatten AI is a web and desktop application designed to solve the "lost source file" problem. It utilizes advanced computer vision and generative AI to analyze flat image files (JPG, PNG, flattened PDF) and decompose them into fully isolated, transparent, and downloadable assets. It reconstructs the hidden background behind elements using inpainting, effectively turning a flat image into an editable layered file (PSD/SVG).2. Problem StatementDesigners frequently face scenarios where they need to modify a design but only have the final export (a flat image).Pain Point: Manually cutting out elements in Photoshop (Pen tool/Lasso) is time-consuming.Pain Point: Removing an object leaves a "hole" in the background, making the background unusable.Pain Point: Text in images cannot be edited or identified easily.3. Target AudienceBrand Designers: Who need to update legacy assets where source files are lost.Motion Designers: Who need to break a flat illustration into parts to animate them (rigging).Marketing Teams: Who need to resize or remix ad creatives without waiting for the original agency to send files.4. User StoriesAs a Designer, I want to upload a flattened JPEG so that I can download just the logo and the product shot as separate transparent PNGs.As a Motion Designer, I want to separate the character from the background and have the AI fill in the missing background data so I can parallax animate the scene.As a Brand Strategist, I want the app to recognize the text on the flyer and suggest the font family used, so I can recreate it.As a User, I want to export the decomposed image directly as a .PSD file with layers preserved.5. Functional Requirements5.1. Input & IngestionFile Support: Must accept JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, and flattened PDF.Resolution: Support for high-resolution uploads (up to 8K or 50MB).Batch Processing: Ability to upload multiple images to decompose simultaneously.5.2. Core AI Processing (The "Deconstruction" Engine)Semantic Segmentation: The system must identify distinct objects (people, products, shapes, logos) and separate them from the background.OCR & Font Recognition: Detect text regions, transcribe the text, and identify/suggest the closest matching Google Font or Adobe Font.Generative Inpainting: When an element is lifted from the background, the AI must generate pixels to fill the empty space behind it (context-aware fill), ensuring the background layer is complete and clean.Vectorization (Optional for MVP): Attempt to convert simple shapes and logos into SVG paths.5.3. The Editor / WorkspaceLayer Panel: A sidebar showing all detected elements as separate layers.Visibility Toggle: Users can turn layers on/off to preview isolation.Manual Refinement: A basic brush tool to add/subtract from the AI's selection mask if it missed a spot.Grouping: Ability to merge two detected fragments into one object.5.4. Export & DownloadIndividual Asset Download: Click a layer to download as PNG (Transparent).Source File Export: "Export as PSD" (Photoshop) where every detected element is a separate layer.Vector Export: "Export as SVG" (for detected icons/shapes).6. Technical Architecture (High Level)6.1. Tech Stack RecommendationFrontend: React.js or Vue.js (for a responsive canvas interface).Backend: Python (Django or FastAPI).AI Models:Segmentation: Meta's SAM (Segment Anything Model) or similar.Inpainting: Stable Diffusion (Inpainting model) or LaMa (Large Mask Inpainting).OCR: Tesseract or Google Cloud Vision API.Infrastructure: AWS S3 (Storage) + GPU Instances (e.g., AWS G5 or specialized AI cloud providers like Lambda Labs).7. UX/UI FlowUpload Screen: Drag and drop area.Processing State: Progress bar showing "Analyzing Composition," "Separating Layers," "Inpainting Backgrounds."Deconstruction View:The main image sits in the center.Hovering over an element highlights it (blue outline).Clicking an element "pops" it out.Right sidebar lists: Background, Text Layer 1, Hero Image, Logo, Shape 1.Export Modal: Checkboxes for which layers to download and format selection.8. Non-Functional RequirementsPerformance: Processing a 4K image should take no longer than 15-20 seconds.Privacy: User images must be deleted from the server after 24 hours (unless they save them to a pro account).Accuracy: Edge detection must be precise (no "halos" or jagged white pixels around cutouts).9. Monetization Strategy (Freemium)Free Tier: 3 images per day, Standard Resolution, PNG export only.Pro Tier: Unlimited images, 4K resolution, PSD Export, Bulk Processing, Priority GPU access.10. Roadmap (Phased Rollout)PhaseFocusKey DeliverablesPhase 1 (MVP)Core SeparationUpload, Segment Anything integration, PNG export of isolated elements.Phase 2ReconstructionGenerative Inpainting (filling the holes), PSD Export.Phase 3Text & VectorOCR, Font Matching, Vectorization of shapes.Phase 4PluginAdobe Photoshop / Figma Plugin integration.
